frequency_question: How often do state supreme courts issue a final ruling on a redistricting challenge within 18 days of docketing?
membership_rule: Includes any state-level supreme court challenge to a legislative or congressional map where an expedited schedule was requested or mandated to meet an election deadline; excludes unaccelerated routine appeals.

coverage_note: 7 prominent named cases; broader universe of state high court emergency dockets is estimated around 12 total instances.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-court trial phases which are assumed complete or bypassed via original jurisdiction petitions.
skeleton: Fast-track supreme court rulings on structural election laws under strict calendar pressure
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 named expedited landmark cases meeting ultra-short structural turnaround times
validity_reason: Judicial administrative rules governing emergency writs and original jurisdiction petitions change slowly over decades.
